## Setup

We start by importing our packages:

```{python}
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import median_abs_deviation
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
import pybiomart as bm
import seaborn as sns

# set plotting theme
sns.set_theme()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
import os
os.chdir("../../course_files")
```

We also import the data we preprocessed in part I. 
To save computational time, we will use a dataset with a subset of 500 cells per sample. 
Of course, in your real data analysis you would use your full dataset.

```{python}
adata = sc.read_h5ad("preprocessed/scanpy/caron_filtered_500.hdf5")
```


## Dimensionality reduction

```{python}
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, n_top_genes=2000, batch_key="sample_id")
```

```{python}
sns.scatterplot(x="means", y="dispersions_norm", hue="highly_variable", 
                data=adata.var)
```

```{python}
sc.pp.pca(adata, svd_solver="arpack", mask_var=adata.var["highly_variable"])
sc.pl.pca_scatter(adata, color="sample_name")
```

```{python}
sc.pl.pca_variance_ratio(adata, n_pcs=50, log=True)
```

```{python}
sc.tl.tsne(adata, use_rep="X_pca")
# visualise
sc.pl.tsne(adata, color="sample_name")
```

```{python}
sc.pp.neighbors(adata, use_rep="X_pca")
sc.tl.umap(adata)
# visualise
sc.pl.umap(adata, color="sample_name")
```
